content_sections.heading: About BSA Hardoi ARP
content_sections.text: The District Basic Education Officer, Hardoi heads basic education in Hardoi district, Uttar Pradesh. Under the Government Order, every development block has 06 Academic Resource Persons: 05 are chosen through this selection process and 01 DIET mentor nominated for the block also works as an ARP. Each urban resource centre also has 05 ARPs.

content_sections.heading: BSA Hardoi ARP Job Description 2026
content_sections.text: ARP working hours are mainly school hours; the ARP can go to the block resource centre only after school hours, as work requires. Supportive supervision of at least 30 unique schools each month (KGBV at most 02 times) through the Prerna Gunvatta app, with actual checklist data filled on the app. Observing teaching-learning and student participation, spot assessment of 05 random students, and demonstrating TLM and running model classes. Observing school activities (prayer assembly, seating, academic calendar, timetable, syllabus progress, TLM, 'Talika' and NIPUN+ app use, library, sports) and giving academic support. Taking part as a resource person in trainings, as directed by the State Project Office. Sending the next month's work plan and tour programme to the DBEO and DIET Principal by the 25th of each month, and an achievement report by the 5th of the following month. Discussing gender equality, life skills, environment sensitivity, road safety, disaster management, bagless days and project-based learning with teachers, and giving feedback. Documenting teachers' innovations and good practices for the district project office and DIET. Promoting the DIKSHA app, PM e-Vidya, Khan Academy and 'The Teacher App'. Attending the monthly BEO–headmaster meeting and 01 teacher cluster meeting, and presenting NBMC data-based analysis. Taking part in district workshops, trainings, seminars, competitions and rallies. Regular attendance is decided on the basis of the report uploaded on the Prerna portal after supportive supervision. ARPs will be trained on academic points at SIEMAT, Prayagraj. A monthly district workshop is held under the DIET Principal, where ARPs present block progress on NBMC data; good performers are honoured at the district level. Top-performing mentors may present at state-level programmes and be sent on educational tours.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BSA Hardoi ARP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 36 vacant Academic Resource Person posts. Hardoi district has 100 ARP posts in all, of which 64 are filled.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the Hardoi ARP application?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Hardoi by registered post by 05:00 PM on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Hardoi ARP post?
faq.answer: Teachers and female teachers working in primary and upper primary schools under the Basic Shiksha Parishad, Uttar Pradesh can apply. They need at least 05 years of teaching experience and at least 05 years of service left.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for the ARP post?
faq.answer: A graduate degree with a teacher training qualification is required. Applicants must also have no pending enquiry and no proven disciplinary action.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an ARP in Hardoi?
faq.answer: The ARP's pay continues from the original working school with no other increase. A mobility allowance of up to Rs. 4500/- per month and a TLM grant of Rs. 500/- per month are paid.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Hardoi ARP post?
faq.answer: Selection is by a 70-mark written examination and a 30-mark interview. The merit list is based on the marks of both.

faq.question: Q7. What are the qualifying marks in the ARP written exam?
faq.answer: Only candidates who score 60% or more in the written examination qualify for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the ARP post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The ARP tenure is 01 year, renewable each year on satisfactory performance, up to a maximum of 03 years. In the declaration, the applicant accepts that there is no permanent claim to the post.

faq.question: Q9. Can an ARP who has completed 03 years apply again?
faq.answer: Such ARPs are ineligible for future selection. However, they may apply again if fewer applications than posts are received.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I get the Hardoi ARP application form?
faq.answer: The form is available on www.hardoi.nic.in, at the District Basic Education Officer office, and at all Block Resource Centre / Nagar Sansadhan Kendra offices.
